purpose: Test utility transport from supervised suffix interventions to full-start verifier-reward RL, and short-to-long RL utility prediction.
families: All 12 primary families, exact ordered 64/64 family/control source IDs in original SFT matching receipts.
optimizer: Fresh empty AdamW for each independent pair arm; uninterrupted state across its two milestones.
stopping: First completed update crossing each proxy threshold, bound and report overshoot; short milestone continues directly to long without reload.
main_rl_settings: Same full-start source sampling, four prompts per update, eight responses each, T=0.8, fixed 512 response denominator, learning rate 5e-5, retained batch 16 at weight 0.1 and separate retention RNG as main seed one.

ranking.metric: matched control whole-reference bits minus family whole-reference bits at T=1, equal weights on 2-6/7-9/10-12 bins
ranking.long_ranking_use: diagnostic only; never choose the better-looking horizon

predictions: SFT 100-update selection utility predicts long-RL utility
Short-RL selection utility predicts long-RL utility
Difference between their Spearman correlations, sign agreement, and mean later utility of each frozen top-three set
Short utility predicts the long-minus-short increment; report alongside total later utility
confirmation_use: Existing confirmation is reused development, with no second independent-confirmation claim.
final_scoring: After global training closure, score every one of 48 family/control short/long checkpoints on final confirmation. Report frozen selection-predictor associations and increments; never rerank or train from final metrics.

mixture_followup.selected: All 64 sources from each short-RL top-three family, one full-start run from common adapted checkpoint, online seed 20260910 and 4e15 proxy ceiling.
mixture_followup.control: New 192-source uniform bank matched to new selected full-source length histogram, same one-seed full-start run/settings. Reuse existing arm only if exact bank order and all trajectory settings coincide.
mixture_followup.existing_primary: All original SFT-selected factorial arms remain unchanged.
mixture_followup.admission: Launch only if all required endpoints and final evaluation can finish before 03:00 UTC; otherwise report unlaunched. No outcome-based early stopping or family omissions.

optional_covariance.decision: Prepared as a secondary fixed-checkpoint diagnostic only if it fits; cannot change mixture ranking.
optional_covariance.projection: Fixed selection-loss gradient at adapted policy, identity preconditioner; sourcewise raw LOO gradient at sampler T=0.8.
optional_covariance.draws: Reuse original adapted full-start candidate groups and independent full-start groups from difficulty_audit_v1; preserve shared source covariance and charge derivatives.
optional_covariance.interpretation: Immediate raw-gradient mechanism, not exact Adam or long-horizon predictor.

scope_limits: Full-start RL versus suffix SFT changes conditioning as well as objective.
Fixed compute does not match update counts or retention exposures.
64-source intervention banks differ from 192-source deployment mixtures.
All acquisition, scoring and validation costs will be reported separately.
Final likelihood ranking does not establish family-level verifier-success ranking.
